notes.subject: ידע תדע
notes.rationale: Infinitive-absolute + verb: 'save tru, save olgeta' — pasin bilong Hibru i strongim tok, miSAVE long Tok Pisin wantaim tupela tok save.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב i bel/tingting bilong man long pasin bilong Tanakh — Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim tingting na laik, orait tasol.

translation: Save tru, save olgeta ol fes bilong ol sipsip na meme bilong yu; putim bel bilong yu long ol grup bilong ol animal.

tokens.gloss: ol sipsip na meme bilong yu
long ol grup bilong ol animal
